summary: Tested Valet Fee Feature for ParKaro platform. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified: admin panel shows valet fee input field, profile save works, dashboard displays PENDING PAYMENT status for tickets with fee gate.
passed_tests: Backend: PUT /api/admin/profile?valet_fee=200 sets valet fee successfully
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve with valet_fee > 1 creates pending_payment ticket
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve returns pending_payment=true and valet_fee in response
Backend: Duplicate retrieval blocked for pending_payment tickets
Backend: PUT /api/admin/profile?valet_fee=0 sets fee to zero
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve with valet_fee = 0 creates claimed ticket directly
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve with valet_fee = 1 creates claimed ticket (threshold is > 1)
Backend: Cleanup - reset valet fee to 0
Frontend: Admin panel shows valet fee input field (data-testid: admin-valet-fee)
Frontend: Admin can save valet fee via profile form (data-testid: admin-profile-save-btn)
Frontend: Profile updated successfully toast appears after save
Frontend: Dashboard shows PENDING PAYMENT status badge for tickets with fee gate
Frontend: Dashboard shows CLAIMED status badge for normal tickets
Frontend: Valet dashboard and admin dashboard load correctly
seed_data_creation: Created test vehicles with TEST-FEE-*, TEST-NOFEE-*, TEST-FEE1-* prefixes during backend testing

mocked_apis.payment_link: Payment link URL (https://pay.parkaro.com/fee/{vehicle_id}) is a placeholder - no real payment processing
mocked_apis.whatsapp_fee_template: WA_TEMPLATE_FEE (HXe832ec474f9a62521d84f7061ec28921) may not be approved by Meta yet but API call succeeds

context_for_next_testing_agent: Valet Fee Feature is fully working. Key features: 1) Admin can set valet_fee in profile section (data-testid: admin-valet-fee). 2) When valet_fee > 1, retrieval creates pending_payment ticket instead of claimed. 3) pending_payment tickets are blocked from duplicate retrieval. 4) When valet_fee = 0 or 1, retrieval creates claimed ticket directly (threshold is > 1). 5) Dashboard shows PENDING PAYMENT status badge for fee-gated tickets. 6) WhatsApp fee payment request is sent via send_fee_payment_request() helper. Payment link is MOCKED (placeholder URL). Previous features (Ghosting Protocol, shift management, etc.) still working.
